name: CONTAGION
text: This turning point, enemies near the warband sicken: Move -2 inches and Hit one worse (never on top of being injured) for an enemy carrying your Poison token within 3 inches of a Plague Marine it can see or be seen by, or for any enemy within 3 inches of your Icon Bearer on the same terms.

name: LUMBERING DEATH
text: This turning point, slow-moving Plague Marines strike true: Ceaseless on their weapons when retaliating, or when shooting or fighting in an activation in which they have covered no more than 3 inches (climbing and Accessible terrain count).

name: CLOUD OF FLIES
text: Drop a swarm marker in the killzone. Shooters more than 3 inches from a Plague Marine sitting wholly within 1 inch of the swarm treat it as obscured. The swarm disperses at the Ready step of the next Strategy phase.

name: NURGLINGS
text: Daemon mites harry one enemy within 3 inches of a Plague Marine, or within 7 if it carries your Poison token (sight not needed): its APL drops by 1 until its next activation ends.

name: VIRULENT POISON
text: Before or after any action of a Plague Marine activation or counteraction, poison one enemy within 3 inches of it, or one it can see within 7 inches. An enemy already poisoned is not affected.

name: SICKENING RESILIENCE
text: Play it as attack dice are about to hurt a friendly Plague Marine: for the rest of this activation or counteraction its Disgustingly Resilient skips the roll and always removes 1 from a die of 3 or more damage, never below 2.

name: POISONOUS DEMISE
text: As a Plague Marine falls, before removal, every enemy it can see within 3 inches is poisoned, or loses 1 wound if it already was (even from earlier in this action). You are offered it when an attack kills it; when other damage kills it the engine plays it for you if you can pay.

name: CURSE OF ROT
text: When a Plague Marine shoots or fights (not retaliates) an enemy within 3 inches, or within 7 if that enemy carries your Poison token: every 3 on that enemy's dice is a failure that cannot be re-rolled and costs it 1 wound. It is called once the enemy has rolled, before anyone re-rolls.
